meta.name: auth-wechat-miniprogram
meta.description: CloudBase WeChat Mini Program native authentication guide. This skill should be used when users need mini program identity handling, OPENID/UNIONID access, or `wx.cloud` auth behavior in projects where login is native and automatic.

copy.tagline: 集成微信小程序原生登录与身份管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发微信小程序并需要处理原生登录和用户身份。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat Mini Program native login and identity management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing a WeChat Mini Program and need native login and user identity handling.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你如何在 CloudBase 微信小程序中实现原生认证，包括初始化 wx.cloud、在云函数中获取用户 OPENID/UNIONID，以及从小程序调用云函数获取身份。
howto.when: 当你询问微信小程序认证、获取用户 OPENID/UNIONID、wx.cloud 认证行为，或需要在小程序云函数中处理用户身份时触发。

如何初始化 CloudBase 并开启用户跟踪？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through native WeChat Mini Program authentication in CloudBase, including initializing wx.cloud, getting user OPENID/UNIONID in cloud functions, and calling cloud functions from the Mini Program to retrieve identity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about WeChat Mini Program authentication, getting OPENID/UNIONID, wx.cloud auth behavior, or handling user identity in mini program cloud functions.

say_en.note: Claude shows sample code using cloud.getWXContext().
